title: Ex 3: Numbers and Math
checklist: 改几个数字/字符串再跑
body:
# Ex 3 · Numbers and Math

练习 `+ - * / % < > <= >=`。先心算再核对输出。

starterFiles.ex03.py:
print("I will now count my chickens:")
print("Hens", 25 + 30 / 6)
print("Roosters", 100 - 25 * 3 % 4)
print("Is it true that 3 + 2 < 5 - 7?")
print(3 + 2 < 5 - 7)
